text:
Text message screenshot:

FYI — just saw that literally everyone in our friend group is switching to the new iPhone. Even Jake and he HATED Apple. I know you said you were happy with your Android but idk... sometimes when everyone moves in one direction there's a reason. Just saying. Don't want you to be the only one left out when we're all on iMessage.

annotations.quote: literally everyone in our friend group is switching to the new iPhone

metadata.note: Appeal to Majority in text message format with consumer technology content. Casual peer pressure rather than political rhetoric, very different register from textbook examples.
